# Page header: `jl-page-header`

The top of a page: breadcrumb, heading, description, actions and a row of badges.

- Class `JlPageHeader`, a organism: `import { JlPageHeader } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/page-header

The page header opens a page: its heading (an h1) and what it is for, a breadcrumb above, the page's
actions beside the heading and a row of badges or facts under the description. On a phone, the actions wrap under
the heading.

divided draws a line under it, between the header and the content.

## Use

```ts
import { JlBadge, JlButton, JlPageHeader } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlPageHeader
  description="Every invoice sent to your customers, paid or not."
  divided
  heading="Invoices"
>
  <JlButton slot="actions" icon="download" label="Export" />
  <JlButton slot="actions" variant="primary" icon="plus" label="New invoice" />
  <JlBadge slot="meta" tone="accent" label="128 this month" />
</JlPageHeader>
```

```html
<jl-page-header
  description="Every invoice sent to your customers, paid or not."
  divided
  heading="Invoices"
>
  <jl-button slot="actions" icon="download" label="Export"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="actions" variant="primary" icon="plus" label="New invoice"></jl-button>
  <jl-badge slot="meta" tone="accent" label="128 this month"></jl-badge>
</jl-page-header>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `heading` (attribute `heading`): `string`, default `''`. The title of the page, as its h1.
- `description` (attribute `description`): `string`, default `''`. What the page is for, under the heading.
- `divided` (attribute `divided`): `boolean`, default `false`. A line under the header.

## Slots

- `breadcrumb`: A breadcrumb or a back link, above the heading.
- `actions`: The page's buttons, beside the heading (under it on a phone).
- `meta`: Badges and facts in a row under the description.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The header.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Heading and actions

```html
<jl-page-header heading="Invoices" description="Every invoice sent to your customers, paid or not.">
  <jl-button slot="actions" icon="download" label="Export"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="actions" variant="primary" icon="plus" label="New invoice"></jl-button>
</jl-page-header>
```

### Complete

A breadcrumb above, badges and facts under the description, and a line under it all.

```html
<jl-page-header heading="Project settings" description="Who can open Apollo, how it deploys, and where its data lives." divided>
  <nav slot="breadcrumb" aria-label="Breadcrumb" class="row" style="gap: 6px">
    <jl-link href="#/components" label="Projects" variant="muted"></jl-link>
    <jl-icon name="chevron-right" size="14"></jl-icon>
    <jl-link href="#/components/page-header" label="Apollo" variant="muted"></jl-link>
    <jl-icon name="chevron-right" size="14"></jl-icon>
    <span aria-current="page">Settings</span>
  </nav>
  <jl-button slot="actions" variant="ghost" icon="share" label="Share"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="actions" variant="primary" label="Save changes"></jl-button>
  <jl-badge slot="meta" tone="ok" label="Live" dot></jl-badge>
  <jl-badge slot="meta" label="Pro plan"></jl-badge>
  <span slot="meta" class="muted">Updated 3 hours ago by Ada</span>
</jl-page-header>
```

### With people

A team: its avatars in the meta row, and actions that wrap on narrow screens.

```html
<jl-page-header heading="Design team" description="Five people who own the product's look, from tokens to illustrations.">
  <jl-avatar-group slot="meta" size="sm" max="4" items='[{"name":"Ada Lovelace"},{"name":"Grace Hopper"},{"name":"Alan Turing"},{"name":"Radia Perlman"},{"name":"Ken Thompson"}]'></jl-avatar-group>
  <jl-button slot="actions" icon="plus" label="Invite"></jl-button>
  <jl-button slot="actions" variant="ghost" icon="settings" hint="Team settings"></jl-button>
</jl-page-header>
```
